description: Test suite for the CallbackVisitor class in the HTTP/2 adapter, verifying handling of connection and stream frames, headers, data, and error conditions.

classes.name: CallbackVisitor
classes.description: Class responsible for visiting and processing HTTP/2 frames and stream events, used in testing.

methods.name: OnFrameHeader
methods.description: Handles incoming frame headers, determines frame type and stream association.

methods.name: OnSettingsStart
methods.description: Handles start of SETTINGS frame processing.

methods.name: OnSettingsEnd
methods.description: Handles end of SETTINGS frame processing.

methods.name: set_stream_close_listener
methods.description: Sets a callback for stream close events.

methods.name: OnBeginHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderForStream
methods.description: Processes individual header fields for a stream.

methods.name: OnEndHeadersForStream
methods.description: Handles the end of headers for a stream.

methods.name: OnBeginDataForStream
methods.description: Handles the start of data frames for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataForStream
methods.description: Processes data chunks for a stream.

methods.name: OnDataPaddingLength
methods.description: Handles padding length in data frames.

methods.name: OnEndStream
methods.description: Marks the end of a stream.
